Package com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest

Class OAuth2AuthorizationCode

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest.OAuth2AuthorizationCode
public final class OAuth2AuthorizationCode extends Object
OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow with PKCE (RFC 6749 §4.1 + RFC 7636). The pure pieces — PKCE pair generation, the S256 challenge derivation, building the authorization-request URL, and parsing the redirect callback — are static and fully unit-tested; only exchangeCode(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) performs live network I/O against the token endpoint.

Typical use: createPkce() → buildAuthorizationUrl(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest.OAuth2AuthorizationCode.Pkce) (open in a browser) → user approves → the redirect carries code + state, parsed by parseRedirect(java.lang.String) → exchangeCode(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) swaps the code (plus the PKCE verifier) for tokens.
